description: This file defines the imagebuilderClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the EC2 Image Builder service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to image building and management.

classes.name: imagebuilderClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the EC2 Image Builder service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: cancelImageCreation
methods.description: Cancels the creation of an image.

methods.name: cancelImageCreationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels the image creation process.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific image.
